features.title: What You Will Learn
features.simpleConversations: Engage in simple conversations in Japanese
features.culture: Learn about Japanese culture and traditions

long.description: N5 for student visa and N4 for SSW and job visa. This course focuses on speaking, pronunciation, listening, reading and writing. The focus is on improving your ability to communicate clearly and effectively.

module1.title: Introduction to Japanese
module1.description: A beginner-friendly introduction to the Japanese language, focusing on basic grammar and vocabulary. You will be introduced to essential phrases and essential Japanese customs.

module2.title: Intermediate Japanese
module2.description: Aimed at intermediate learners, this module dives into more complex sentence structures, kanji, and conversation practice.

module3.title: Advanced Japanese
module3.description: For advanced learners, this module focuses on fluent conversation, complex reading and writing, and cultural nuances.

module4.title: Business Japanese
module4.description: Specialized course for those who need Japanese for business contexts, including formal language, business etiquette, and professional writing.

short.description: 3 Months Basic Japanese Learning Course. It covers speaking, reading, and basic cultural awareness in a fun, interactive format.

module1.title: Survival Japanese
module1.description: A crash course for travelers, teaching basic expressions and polite phrases for everyday situations like ordering food or asking for directions.

module2.title: Japanese for Tourists
module2.description: Focuses on travel-specific vocabulary, common questions, and phrases to help you navigate Japan with ease.

private.description: Take your Japanese learning experience to the next level with our flexible evening courses designed to fit your busy schedule. Whether you are a beginner or looking to improve your conversation skills, our evening classes offer structured learning in a group setting, helping you progress at a steady pace.

module1.title: Beginners Japanese
module1.description: A one-on-one lesson designed for absolute beginners. Learn the basics, including pronunciation, simple sentences, and basic kanji.

module2.title: Advanced Japanese Conversation
module2.description: Improve your speaking skills with private lessons focused on advanced topics like debates, current events, and business Japanese.

onlineLearning.title: Online Learning
onlineLearning.description: Access our Japanese language courses from anywhere in the world. Learn at your own pace with our comprehensive online curriculum.

features.videoLessonsDesc: Personalized Japanese courses with adaptive methods to support every learner's pace and confidence.
features.interactiveMaterialsDesc: Advanced training for top students, focusing on complex grammar, fluency, and exam preparation.
features.liveClassesDesc: A structured curriculum with balanced reading, writing, speaking, and listening for steady progress.

about.title: About Us
about.paragraph1: Japan Ambition Training Center is one of the leading Japanese language training center in Bangladesh. It offers an easy learning method for Bangladeshi students. The courses are designed especially for the Bangladeshi students.
about.paragraph2: Japan Ambition Training Center has an extraordinary learning method to make each of the students eloquent in Japanese language. This easiest method ensures highest skill in Japanese Language.
about.paragraph3: At the same time, Japan Ambition Training Center ensures the suitable course fee for all the students of Bangladesh.

titp.description: Comprehensive support for Technical Intern Training Program applicants, including documentation preparation, training, and placement with Japanese companies.

ssw.description: End-to-end assistance for Specified Skilled Worker visa applications, helping qualified workers find opportunities in Japan's industries with labor shortages.
